text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Haaah, I'm so glad it ended with only minor injuries.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Still... I'm sorry, but
I can't just sit quietly and rest until it heals!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Actually, tomorrow, one of my classmates was kind enough
to invite me for a training run together!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Plus there's the concert this weekend...!!
Urgh, I can't bear the thought of empty seats in the venue...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
An injury like this won't make me give up.
I have so many things I want to do!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally fine, and I can move around with no problem!
Come on, let's get back to training!
choice_data_list: Let's make sure to get some proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: N-No way...! But I'm totally fine...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I've got training to do and oshi to support, there's no time to be resting...!
choice_data_list: For racing and hobbies alike, your health is everything!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ugh…… Completely undeniable logic…….

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed, you can't enjoy anything
if you aren't healthy... *sigh*..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After encouraging a disappointed Agnes Digital,
I made sure she got plenty of rest.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yes! As expected of you, Trainer~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Just you watch♪
An injury like this is nothing on easy mode compared to my love for Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Mmh-guuuh! Nope, impossible!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, that was one epic setup...
After playing around so much, too...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"No... I promised the Umamusume...!
The live concert...! I'm definitely going... Ouch...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital pushed herself too hard
and worsened her injury...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
How does it look, Trainer!?
I'm moving without any issues, right!
choice_data_list: Yeah, it looks like it'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight! Then both training and
the concert are going full steam ahead, right on schedule!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Agnes Digital was able to resume her training.
